briefs.text: RCB beat KKR by 7 wickets.
Abu Dhabi T10: Aces meet Bulls in the qualifier.
Sydney Thunder women beat Brisbane Heat.
IPL 2027 mini-auction is set for Goa.
Arshdeep breaks into the ODI top 20; Rohit slips.
Duckett 133 as England beat Australia by 97 runs.
India beat Malaysia in the Hong Kong Open badminton.
Anthropic staff hold ~$232bn; founders ~$20bn each.
Anthropic lets staff sell 10% of locked shares.
COP31 and ITU launch the Antalya AI Pledge.
APEC: Xi urges open trade on emerging tech.
Akvan: fishermen ashore; Odisha coast schools shut.
Akvan is the Bay's third cyclone in weeks.
Iran named the storm Akvan — a demon of the Shahnameh.
Riyadh fears a new Yemen war could last six months.
Iran's missile output continues, but slowly.
New START has lapsed; no arms treaty caps arsenals.
Bavuma ruled out of the Bangladesh Test decider.
Rising Stars begins in Doha; India A face Nepal.
Women's Asian Hockey Champions Trophy begins.
